findings.title: Ambiguous finalization still permits automatic query refetch after remount
findings.details: The recovery lock disables the Refresh button and window-focus refetching, but the measurement query retained React Query's default refetch-on-mount behavior. Because its stale time was zero, remounting the panel with a persisted pending or ambiguous recovery record could issue an automatic measurement read even though recovery is meant to permit only an exact retry or an explicit authoritative saved-result check.

acceptanceGaps: The remount-recovery checks did not explicitly cover a stale cached query remount and assert that no automatic refetch is dispatched while persisted finalization recovery exists.
evidence: The prior repair findings for shared synchronous collection/finalization dispatch and equal-stateVersion cache writes were addressed.
The missing refetch-on-mount recovery boundary required a second repair round.
